description: This source file implements inotify backend for fsnotify on Linux, managing file system event watching, handling inotify events, watch registration, removal, and event processing.

classes.name: inotify
classes.description: Struct managing inotify file descriptor, watch list, event channels, and internal state for Linux filesystem monitoring.

classes.name: watches
classes.description: Struct maintaining mappings between watch descriptors and paths, supporting watch management.

classes.name: watch
classes.description: Represents a single watch with descriptor, path, flags, and recursion flag.

classes.name: koekje
classes.description: Struct used for storing inotify move cookies and associated paths for tracking file moves.

methods.name: newWatches
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new watches map.

methods.name: newBackend
methods.description: Initializes a new inotify backend, setting up inotify instance, channels, and starting event reading.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the inotify instance and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a watch on the specified path.

methods.name: AddWith
methods.description: Adds a watch with options on the specified path, supporting recursive watching.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a watch on a path with specific flags and recursion option.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a watch on the specified path.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Internal method to remove watch descriptors associated with a path.

methods.name: WatchList
methods.description: Returns a list of currently watched paths.

methods.name: readEvents
methods.description: Continuously reads inotify events, processes them, and sends Event objects through channels.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Processes a raw inotify event, updates internal state, and generates a high-level Event.

methods.name: isRecursive
methods.description: Checks if a given path is watched recursively.

methods.name: newEvent
methods.description: Creates a new Event object from inotify event data.

methods.name: xSupports
methods.description: Indicates support for all event operations.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Outputs current watch descriptors and paths for debugging.
